description: One row of desk v2 navigation, serving both the rail and the sidebar.

fields.description: Frozen address every site and user edit is filed against. Never changed once shipped.
fields.label: Key

fields.description: Key of the row this one sits under. Blank, or naming a missing row, means top level.
fields.label: Parent Key

fields.description: What this row opens. Required on an item, blank on a delta over a lower layer's item.
fields.label: Type

fields.description: Fetched from the type's Target DocType when blank; only a Record row sets its own.
fields.label: Link DocType

fields.description: Type-specific JSON, such as a Link row's open-in-new-tab. Never a filter or a saved query.
fields.label: Payload

fields.description: Shown as typed, never translated. Blank falls back to the type's label, then the destination.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: Whether a collapsible row starts folded.
fields.label: Keep Closed

fields.description: Site and user layers only: a delta against a shipped row, or an item this layer added.
fields.label: Customization

fields.description: Hides the item. Explicit, so a user's unticked Hidden can un-hide what the site hid.
fields.label: Hidden

fields.description: 0: a delta against the base row with this key. 1: an item this layer added outright.
fields.label: Added

fields.description: JSON list of fieldnames this delta has an opinion about, so a blank can clear a shipped value.
fields.label: Overrides

fields.description: Where a contributed row lands. A site or user layer's moves are stored as anchors too.
fields.label: Contribution

fields.description: Ordered JSON list of placements naming after, before or parent_key. First to resolve wins.
fields.label: Anchors

fields.description: Following this row leaves the host app for the app that contributed it.
fields.label: Switches App

name: Navigation Item
